name: estimator-mechanism
assertion: is a fitted or fixed estimator producing a typed output

children.name: split-based
children.assertion: partitions feature space by threshold comparisons; scale-insensitive by mechanism

children.name: weighted-sum
children.assertion: forms a (possibly link-transformed) linear/additive combination of features; scale-sensitive; coefficient-interpretable

children.name: distance-kernel
children.assertion: decisions depend on geometric distances/similarities in feature space; scale-sensitive

children.name: probabilistic-generative
children.assertion: fits a probability model of the data (likelihood/density) and infers latent structure

children.name: recurrence-temporal
children.assertion: models a value as a function of its own past / time index (autoregression, smoothing, counting)

nonMechanisticFacet.note: do not learn an estimator mechanism; handled by facet, not tree leaf
